source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: No hole map found. The club has two courses; this one is taken to be the 18 holes north of Village Boulevard (the lake-filled side), with the Links across the road. The hole order and which way each hole plays are worked out from the photo and the card's lengths and pars only, so every hole number is a best guess.
unsure.1: Tee placed at the south end of the fairway by the lake near the clubhouse; the back tee may be across the water.
unsure.4: Tee placed at the south tip of the strip west of the big lake; the card's back tee (419 yd) is further than any tee seen.
unsure.8: Par 3 played across water to the green on the small peninsula; could equally be a green of another hole.
unsure.9: The line to this green crosses water; the real tee is not clear.
unsure.10: Tee placed by the road south-east of the clubhouse; traced short of the card (236 yd vs 260-410).
unsure.12: Tee placed on the peninsula north of the 11th green; traced short of the card's back tee.
unsure.15: Played as a dogleg from the tees at the north edge round the lake to the green on the west shore; direction is a guess.
unsure.18: Line crosses the long lake from the peninsula to the green near the clubhouse; tee position is a guess.
